stories.title: Anthropic AI model finds Linux kernel bug that leads to remote root access
stories.why: Linux servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) could be vulnerable to remote code execution through a flaw in the kernel’s networking stack.

stories.title: Securing MCP servers before the AI rollout outpaces security
stories.why: Your company’s CTO has a plan to implement your company’s first LLM-based application. The board approved it, and now you’re finding out about it. It’s a typical story I hear all the time, and I’ve lived it myself.

stories.title: Vulnerability exploitation rising as the root cause of many breaches
stories.why: More evidence has emerged that attackers are turning to vulnerabilities rather than phishing as a means for breaking into corporate systems.

stories.title: Beyond deterministic worms: Preparing the SOC for reasoning adversaries
stories.why: In May 2017, the WannaCry cryptoworm spread across the internet, compromising more than 200,000 computers in at least 100 countries.

stories.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
stories.why: 26,400 credentials that developers left in public code on Gitee, a Chinese code-hosting service, still worked when a researcher tested them. Anyone who copied one from that code could have used it.

stories.title: In Other News: Anthropic Breach Dispute, UEFI Flaw Hits Most Servers, Cloudflare AI Data Leak
stories.why: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Iran eyed in military freezer hacks, Copenhagen University breach, AI-powered malware.

stories.title: Researchers find bugs in 5 AI developer tools, with OpenAI and Microsoft flaws still unpatched
stories.why: Embedded browsers are at the heart of the problem

stories.title: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw With 9.8 CVSS Score Affects Ubuntu, Red Hat and Other Distributions
stories.why: A flaw in the Linux kernel's TCP code, tracked as CVE-2026-98432, affects Ubuntu, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and other Linux distributions. The kernel's own CVE team rates it 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS scale.

stories.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Leads Benchmarks for Finding, Exploiting, and Patching Vulnerabilities
stories.why: Google on Wednesday took the wraps off Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.

stories.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
stories.why: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed.
